turnaround_reason: Coty fell from $4.93 to ~$2.90 on soft beauty demand, revenue declines, and heavy leverage that turns it into a highly geared equity stub. The recovering-mode read is a bet that its transformation cost program and easier comps stabilize margins — but it reports fiscal Q4 earnings TODAY (Aug 19, after close), which is the dominant near-term risk.
bullish_points: Transformation program on track for $200M+ savings by FY26 end; YTD FCF up 14% to ~$276M
Deeply de-rated: forward P/E ~8.4, P/B ~0.83, EV/EBITDA ~7.4; sits below book
Insider buying earlier in 2026 (director von Bretten 83k sh @ $2.41; CFO 5k @ $2.65)
Management expects sequential improvement in both Prestige and Consumer Beauty on easier comps
Strong owned/licensed fragrance portfolio (Burberry, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Kylie)
bearish_points: Reports fiscal Q4 tonight (Aug 19) — a binary event that dwarfs any pre-print positioning; consensus is a ~$0.01 loss on revenue ~$1.2B (-~5% YoY)
Dangerous balance sheet: $3.4B debt, D/E ~98, current ratio 0.82, negative TTM profit margin (-9%)
Revenue declining (-1.3% TTM) in a soft global beauty market
Sub-$3 price with high leverage makes the equity a volatile, option-like stub
Sampled options IV in dossier looks like bad data (~0%); treat greeks as unreliable
catalyst: Fiscal Q4 FY2026 earnings tonight — guidance on FY27 margins/savings and any debt-reduction progress will set direction
suggested_trade: Pass / avoid sizing into tonight's print. Revisit after earnings; only a tiny speculative starter if the report confirms margin recovery and deleveraging.
key_risk: Tonight's print misses or guides down on a highly levered balance sheet, sending a sub-$3 stub sharply lower with little margin for error.
would_skip_if: Holding into an unhedged binary earnings event with this leverage — which is why conviction is low pre-print.
